campaign.title: Rootfall Verge
campaign.detail: Follow the waypoint. Optional supply routes branch from the service path.

transmission.speaker: ECHO
transmission.text: Follow the surviving archive signal through the fallen forest relay.

beats.title: Mara’s seed nursery
beats.hint: Follow the copper cable to the dry nursery. Two connections bring it back.
beats.result: Mara: The seed beds are drinking again. Take the nursery’s spare plating. +35 armor.

beats.title: Ivo’s canopy receiver
actions: Look at the gold receiver and lock signal
beats.hint: Stand at the sighting dish; look toward the gold receiver and press E.
beats.result: Ivo: The lost crew’s rescue frequency. Take their scattergun and reserve ammunition.

beats.hint: At the sighting dish, face the gold receiver. The silent choir can sing again.
beats.result: ECHO: A civilian band. The choir answers. Scattergun and reserve ammo released.

beats.title: Patch’s beacon garden
beats.hint: Light the two ends of the garden cable. Leave a path home for Mara, Ivo and Patch.
beats.result: Mara: We can see the way home. Take the last repair plates. +35 armor.
